reviewer: Codex strict visual QA with in-app browser contact-sheet review
rules: Any random hash/polygon fallback is a fix, not ok.
Badges must be detached from the base metaphor and remain readable at 18px.
Panel icons may not be meaningless lines in a frame; they must use semantic motifs or explicit text fallback.
File-type icons use committed font-path extension labels inside one shared document shell.
Brand-adjacent exports are review unless product usage proves a domain-specific Myoxus icon would be clearer.
Text glyphs are generated from committed font outlines, not hand-drawn pseudo letters.
resolvedFixFamilies: Delete and Filter detached action badges
Alias, Appearance, AllDocs, AddOrganize, ArchiveRestore, AutoTidyUp
Panel routing and fixed-size panel text/typography
Panel motifs: Flash, Light, Settings, Sunglass
ColorPicker, Database, Direction, Discord, Eraser, Organization
